home-economics-2023-hl-sa-q3-scheme.alt: Official table of food-poisoning bacteria and associated high-risk foods. Salmonella: eggs, meat, fish, poultry, milk, cheese. E-coli: milk, cheese, meat, polluted water. Listeria: cheese, pâté, cook chill foods, coleslaw, milk, meat, ice cream, seafood. Clostridium botulinum: canned fish/food, vacuum packed meat, milk, cheese, yoghurt. Clostridium perfringens/welchii: vegetables. Staphylococcus aureus: meat, milk, cheese. Bacillus cereus: cooked rice, cereals, herbs. Campylobacter: milk, poultry, shellfish. Each published list is non-exhaustive.

home-economics-2023-hl-sc-q1bi-scheme.alt: SEC scheme: Property; Explanation; Example. Reflected: rays bounce off a shiny surface; mirrors, polished porcelain, light colours on walls, gloss paint, glazed wall tiles. Diffused: rays scatter through translucent substances or on a non-reflecting surface; net curtains, frosted glass, translucent lampshades. Absorbed: dark and matt surfaces absorb light; dark painted walls, brick walls, stone. Dispersed: a prism or crystal splits rays into component colours; chandeliers. Refracted: thick or ridged glass bends rays; glass bricks, double glazing.
